title: Hard Days Build Strong People | A Discipline Short Film
lines: Today was hard. He almost didn't finish.
The weight is heavy. The legs are shaking.
But strong people aren't built on easy days.
Pressure is what turns carbon into diamond.
If it were easy, everyone would do it. That's why it's valuable.
Thank the hard days. They're doing the work on you.
You are not breaking. You are being built.
